mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, tenant_name, short_name, country, reg_number, logo_url, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, status, subscription_id, expired_at FROM tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.tenant_code, t.tenant_name, t.short_name, t.country, t.reg_number, t.contact_name, t.contact_email, t.contact_phone, t.status, t.create_time, a.applicant_role FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN application a ON a.tenant_id = t.id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.id != 1
AND t.tenant_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tenantCode}, '%')
AND t.tenant_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%')
AND t.status = #{status}
ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_code, tenant_name, short_name, country, reg_number, logo_url, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, status, review_comment, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, subscription_id, expired_at, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM tenant WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant (tenant_code, tenant_name, short_name, country, reg_number, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, status, sort_order, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantCode}, #{tenantName}, #{shortName}, #{country}, #{regNumber}, #{contactName}, #{contactEmail}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET status = #{status}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE tenant SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
